project.name: NirmalTag
project.description: AI-Verified Sanitary & Special-Care Waste Segregation Platform

findings.auth_mismatch: Firebase ID Token is not exchanged for Supabase JWT; auth.uid() evaluates to NULL in RLS policies.
findings.role_security: Roles are stored in client localStorage/state rather than verified against Supabase user_roles table.
findings.ai_engine: TensorFlow Lite dependency declared in Gradle, but assets/mobilenet_v3.tflite is missing; UI uses simulated inference.
findings.offline_persistence: Room DB & WorkManager dependencies declared, but Kotlin Entity/DAO/Worker classes are missing.
findings.tag_persistence: Tag lifecycle defined in SQL schema, but UI actions operate on component memory state without DB writes.
